properties.name: Tool surface
properties.purpose:
The served tool surface, cut into twelve slices by lifecycle phase: capture, ingest, ask, coherence, assure, as-built, claims, exchange, query, operate, temporal and skills.

⚠️ TWELVE CHILDREN, DELIBERATELY OVER THE 3-7 BAND, and the excess is the finding rather than a defect to fix. These slices are already a partition of ONE thing — a single surface, divided once by the phase of the loop each tool serves. Splitting them further to reach seven would be using span of control as a GENERATOR, which `dec:idea-the-decomposition-ladder-is-open` and the whole depth-is-a-consequence argument forbid: the band said 25 was wrong, it does not say 12 is.

Anthony's call, 2026-08-25, put to him with the alternative: *"leave it at 12 — don't invent a rung."*
